meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会通过语言服务器协议（LSP）检查当前工作区的代码：列出可用的语言服务器、获取文件的诊断信息、跳转到定义、查找引用、查看符号，并在重命名前做安全检查、执行重命名。
howto.when: 当你在当前工作区提到“诊断”、“定义”、“引用”、“符号”或“重命名”等需求时触发；若诊断提示缺少语言服务器，也会先调用状态检查。

say.text: 检查当前文件的诊断错误
say.note: 返回该文件的 LSP 诊断结果

say.text: 找到这个函数的所有引用
say.note: 跨工作区列出所有用到它的位置
先检查能否重命名，再应用修改

howto.what_en: Claude uses LSP tools to check code in the workspace: lists configured language servers, fetches diagnostics for a file, jumps to definitions, finds references, inspects symbols, and validates or applies renames.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for code diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety in the current workspace. It also runs lsp.status first if a language server is reported missing.

say_en.note: Returns LSP diagnostics for the file

say_en.text: Find all references to this function
say_en.note: Lists every usage across the workspace
Checks rename validity, then applies changes
